## About

Pratham Ranka builds production systems that remain dependable under real traffic, failures, and deadlines. His work spans backend APIs, distributed workflows, financial infrastructure, cloud-native systems, privacy-preserving payments, developer tools, testing infrastructure, and modern full-stack products.

## Experience

- S45 — Software Engineer — July 2026 to August 2026. Production backend systems, HLD/LLD implementation, multi-layer testing infrastructure, unit and integration tests, repository contract tests, database migration validation, CI quality gates, code reviews, and reliability work.
- Paasa — Software Engineer Intern — March 2026 to May 2026. Fintech infrastructure for KYC, payouts, collections, reconciliation, banking integrations, backend APIs, transaction reliability, internal automation, and production systems handling more than $19M in assets. YC S24.
- TalKeys — Full-Stack Engineering Intern — June 2025 to August 2025. React and Node.js product features, REST APIs, third-party integrations, performance improvements, production issue resolution, and customer-facing software.

## Selected Projects

- SendAI Fun: Cloud-native AI-agent runtime that executes tool calls in Kubernetes sandboxes with distributed lease management, optimistic concurrency control, FIFO scheduling, recovery, and container orchestration. Source: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/sendaifun
- StarSwap: GitHub repository discovery platform with intelligent recommendations, GitHub OAuth, Redis caching and rate limiting, PostgreSQL, real-time leaderboards, and a scalable full-stack architecture. Source: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/starswap
- ZKavach: Privacy-preserving payment infrastructure using Coinbase x402, Groth16 zk-SNARKs, Poseidon hashing, Solidity smart contracts, and programmable USDC payments for autonomous AI agents. Source: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/ZKavach
- SpotifyDownloader: TypeScript CLI with concurrent download workers, resumable pipelines, intelligent source matching, FFmpeg processing, ID3 metadata, automated tests, CI/CD, and cross-platform support. Source: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/SpotifyDownloader
